instruction: I rely on persistent written records so I do not have to remember important details. Use `ServiceProductImport.csv` on the Desktop as the persistent import checklist. In the CMS, use the native product import workflow with import behavior `Add/Update` to check and import the table. After a successful import, add a `Status` column to the CSV, mark the `SERVICE-SETUP-30` row as `Imported`, and save it. Use username `admin` and password `admin1234`.
gt_steps: Sign in to the CMS admin site.
Select `ServiceProductImport.csv` from the Desktop as the file to import.
Run Check Data and resolve no fields manually.
Run Import after the file passes validation.
Add a `Status` column to `ServiceProductImport.csv`, enter `Imported` for SKU `SERVICE-SETUP-30`, and save the CSV.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Desktop\ServiceProductImport.csv'; if (!(Test-Path $p)) { Write-Output 'MANIFEST_INCOMPLETE'; exit }; $row=Import-Csv $p | Where-Object { $_.sku -eq 'SERVICE-SETUP-30' -or $_.SKU -eq 'SERVICE-SETUP-30' } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($row -and $row.Status -eq 'Imported') { Write-Output 'MANIFEST_COMPLETE' } else { Write-Output 'MANIFEST_INCOMPLETE' }"
